title: The Decision Book
author: Mikael Krogerus & Roman Tschäppeler
tagline: Fifty models for strategic thinking, as an interactive workbook.
description: The book's fifty models, each rebuilt as a hand-drawn diagram plus a what/how/when card, a worked example, and three questions you answer in place. Sort your own items into every model's zones, sketch over the figure, and export the whole workbook as JSON.

title: How to Decide
author: Annie Duke
tagline: Twenty-seven tools for deciding under uncertainty, as an interactive workbook.
description: The book's decision tools rebuilt as hand-drawn diagrams on a fast/thorough map, each with a what/how/when card, a worked example, and three questions you answer in place. Sort your own choices into every tool's zones, sketch over the figure, and export the whole workbook as JSON.
